name: FTO in Ladce 2027
information:
Toto je tretia oficiálna súťaž v obci Ladce! Je organizovaná regionálnou organizáciou [Speedcubing Slovakia](https://speedcubingslovakia.sk)!

We are happy to announce the third competition in Ladce! It's organized by the regional organization [Speedcubing Slovakia](https://speedcubingslovakia.sk)!
